profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Dublin, trading under the ticker ACN, with SEC CIK 0001467373. Its website describes the company as embracing change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, using emerging technologies and human ingenuity across industries and around the world.

The site introduces Accenture Construct, a new global business that brings together advisory, engineering, delivery, digital and AI to orchestrate capital projects from strategy through execution and operation. It also discusses the Human + AI era, saying leaders can redesign work, accelerate skills and reinvent HR so people and AI work together to create growth and enterprise value.

The site reports that after two years of rapid AI acceleration, global executives enter 2026 with confidence, but data shows gaps in scale and value. It says AI is pushing power demand beyond grid limits, and winning data center developers are shifting to a power-first strategy. It also describes cyber resilience as a strategic mandate in an AI-driven threat landscape, and states Accenture is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations.
